Paragraph: "Then on seeing the great archers Rama and Lakshmana the ministers of Sugreeva have gone from that mountain terrace to another high-peaked mountain..."
Situation/Problem_Faced: Immediate physical threat response forcing relocation to higher ground.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: The monkey leaders retreat geographically to increase their defense advantage.
Outcome/Resolution: They temporarily escape to a higher peak to assess the situation safely.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Anxiety: Avoidance Behavior, Tactical Retreat, Flight Response

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Retreating to higher peaks symbolizes rising above immediate reactive emotion to seek higher perspective.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Behavioral avoidance/flight: physically removing oneself from a perceived threat source to gain psychological safety.
